### UTC Date & Time

[February 23, 2026, 15:00 UTC](https://savvytime.com/converter/utc/feb-23-2026/3pm)

### Agenda


## Agenda

### 1. Versioning Proposal Review

**Proposal Document**: [Execution APIs v1.0.0 - Versioning Proposal](https://hackmd.io/@bomanaps/rJiHuPFOZl),  [ethereum-magicians](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/repo-endpoint-level-versioning-for-the-json-rpc-api-seeking-community/27765?u=bomanaps)

Review the v1.0.0 versioning proposal and gather team input on:

- [ ] Overall scope agreement (71 methods, through Cancun fork)
- [ ] PRs to merge before tagging ([#753](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/753), [#742](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/742))
- [ ] Deferred items list approval

### 2. Open Questions Requiring Team Decision

| Question | Options | Related Issue |
|----------|---------|---------------|
| **Error code standardization** | A) Before v1 (delays release) B) Defer to v2 | [#658](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/issues/658), [#650](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/issues/650) |
| **Test coverage gap** (11 methods) | A) Block v1 until complete B) Release with gaps | [#737](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/issues/737) |
| **eth_simulateV1 maxUseGas** | A) Include in v1 B) Defer to v1.1 | [#746](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/746) |
| **EIP-1898 compliance** | A) Full compliance before v1 B) Document current state | [#713](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/issues/713) |

### 3. Open Issues

| Issue | Title | Priority |
|-------|-------|----------|
| [#690](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/issues/690) | API versioning via GitHub releases/tags | **Critical** |
| [#658](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/issues/658) | Standardize JSON-RPC Error codes | **Critical** |
| [#713](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/issues/713) | Fully apply EIP-1898 in specs | High |
| [#737](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/issues/737) | Missing Test Coverage for 11 methods | Medium |
| [#663](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/issues/663) | GenericTransaction Should Contain `data` | Medium |

### 4. Open PRs

| PR | Title | Author | Status |
|----|-------|--------|--------|
| [#753](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/753) | Fix: engine nits | - | Ready for merge |
| [#747](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/747) | Add `testing_buildBlockV1` RPC Method | Pandas | Needs Marius review |
| [#746](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/746) | Add `maxUseGas` field to `eth_simulateV1` | - | Discussion needed |
| [#742](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/742) | test(debug_getRawReceipts): post-Byzantium block | - | Ready for merge |
| [#735](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/735) | EIP-8025 | - | Deferred |
| [#726](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/726) | Add EIP-7928 Block-level Access Lists | - | Deferred |

### 5. Outdated / Stalled PRs

Review and decide: close or revive?

*Identified in previous meeting - several PRs from 2023 may be abandoned*
